#286 at c58deb2a58e5d86ab0b7493c6e2ac5833bca21fd — PASS

Final round 2 under C34. B286-001 and the round-1 documentation notes are
resolved. No new finding requiring a PM ruling; no third review round.

**Repair:** `activityObserved` is updated synchronously when a transition is
requested, before transport guards or promise queueing. Context-only reports
use that observed state, preserving transitions already queued or in flight.
Boot resets it from the active runtime's isIdle() rather than inheriting a
previous lifecycle's state. `activityPublished` remains separate for successful
acknowledgements and the existing shutdown-repair guard. Turn-end versus
agent-end behavior, admission, control execution and transport ordering are
unchanged.

**Proof:** copied the four committed regressions and their exact boot fixture
into a dependency-free Node execution with assertion/wait/spy shims, not a
local Vitest installation. All four pass against c58deb2 production source;
substituting the exact d55bb57 runtime source makes all four fail with the
expected reversed states: arming behind idle, arming behind working, actual
re-attachment behind working, and a new lifecycle's idle boot after working.
Receipt: review-286-r2-regressions.log. This verifies the repair and the tests'
ability to detect its absence without an extra mutation inventory.

Authoritative full TS suite: CI run 44710347001 is bound to the exact c58deb2
head. Both Node checks, Rust lint and Rust tests pass. check(24) records
125 runtime tests, 25 daemon-http tests, 28 index.fyi tests, 110 test files and
2366 tests passing; typecheck and Biome lint pass. No dependency installation
or node_modules symlink was made in the review tree (C25).

Full local `harness checks` completed with exit 1: Rust workspace fmt/clippy/
tests, route inventory, smoke, pij-skill, native Copilot contracts and SDK pass.
The same eight round-1 tooling stages fail: absent tsx/dependencies prevent
local-paths, omp-config, ddocs, coverage, typecheck, lockfile and test; the
ambient Biome is incompatible with the repository's v2 configuration.
Attribution warns because tsx is absent. No local Vitest tests executed and
no green local aggregate is claimed. These known C25 review-tree limitations
are not new PR findings. Receipt: review-286-r2-checks.json.

**Notes resolved:** docs/how/pij-rs-api.md and D-F199-1 now say the report fires
after every re-attach, whether or not it registers again, and that the control
map retains one entry per distinct reporting seat ID since daemon boot,
including dead seats. Existing mutex/key-clone cost is stated accurately.

**Scope/cost:** relative to actual main base 435245a6, the PR still changes the
same 16 F199 files. The requested 435245a6^1 comparison additionally includes
F234's two store files from #285; those are inherited main, not new F199
changes. c58deb2 is the merge commit. Since round 1, the functional repair
touches only the runtime and its test; two documentation files clarify notes.
The repair adds one synchronous constant-time state assignment on existing
activity transitions and boot, no new HTTP posts, loop, timer, poll or launch.

The earlier advisory-only receipt, incarnation, bounded 422 fallback,
shell-quoting/shared state helper and legacy-queue conclusions still apply:
none of that production code changed in the repair.

The harness improvement is encoded in the four committed delayed-transport
regressions; the resolved lesson was recorded through the reviewer memory
writer at governance commit be4224e00f29437c6a4d1bee63ab8fc45f758df8.
Review source remained unchanged, and the reviewer holding is retained until
merge.
